Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: Central Bank of Libya (CBL) operates instant payment services “LYPay” and “OnePay” and publishes official usage statistics, indicating the instant payment system is live and used for transfers and merchant purchases (POS), with millions of clients/subscribers and billions of LYD processed.

Comments: CBL-related reporting indicates ~4.29 million mobile banking subscribers (digital channel users). Using 2025 population ~7.46 million, this implies ~57%+ of population are mobile banking app subscribers, supporting a 50–69% bracket.
